parameter_refs.name: authority_channel
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source-reviewed device or actual police officer

quote: It is unlawful for the driver of any vehicle: To fail to obey an official traffic-control device or the directions of a police officer at a railroad crossing.

activation.condition: A motor vehicle driver approaches an actual railroad crossing governed by an official traffic-control device or a police officer.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Placement, erection authority, traffic purpose, governing movement and legal status require independent original source review.
Actual officer identity, direction timing, governed movement and communication require independent original source review.

obligation.description: Do not fail to obey the applicable official traffic-control device or police officer directions at the railroad crossing.

timing.description: Join the original instruction history to actual vehicle body approach, entry, halt and exit; no numeric legal threshold is supplied.
